quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Raymond Felton on his top 5 point guards

quotes.quote: It's obvious SGA is number one. Brunson, he won the finals. He won the championship, got a chip. He got a chip. He got a chip. But the way he did it, the last game, my nigga was amazing. The way he did it was elite. He is for sure top five.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Raymond Felton on why Luka Doncic is his third-ranked point guard

quotes.quote: My third was Luka. I mean that's pretty self-explanatory. Because if he's very talented but it doesn't have a chip, doesn't have a finals MVP, doesn't have a championship.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Raymond Felton on why he ranks Shai Gilgeous-Alexander so highly
quotes.excerpt: He was a number one option. He averaged 30 something. He did it in a league where Michael Jordan was in the league.
quotes.quote: He was a number one option. He averaged 30 something. He did it in a league where Michael Jordan was in the league.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Raymond Felton on why he ranks Jaylen Brown ahead of Luka Doncic

quotes.quote: In my eyes, Jaylen Brown surpassed Luka. Because at the end of the day, his team won the championship. Jaylen won.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Raymond Felton on why he values team success
quotes.excerpt: They just don't fucking give it to you. So it's not an asterisk. So to me, in my point of view, it's an asterisk.
quotes.quote: They just don't fucking give it to you. So it's not an asterisk. So to me, in my point of view, it's an asterisk. For me.
